Proceedings And Order

DATED 02.05.2025 PASSED BY THE III RD ADDL CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC BELAGAVI IN CC NO.1279/2025 THEREBY TAKING COGNIZANCE FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/S.
498A, 323, 504, 506 R/W 34 OF THE IPC AND ALLOW THE ABOVE CRIMINAL PETITION AS AGAINST PETITIONER NO.1 AND 2/ACCUSED NO.1 AND 2, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 ORAL ORDER (PER: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V.SRISHANANDA) Case called out, none present on behalf of the petitioner.
Even on the last date of hearing, there was no representation.
2. Suo motu this Court listed the matter to today in the interest of justice.

3. On perusal of the material on record, it is noticed that the petitioner is challenging the issuance of the process and seeking quashing of the pending proceedings in C.C.No.1279/2025 for the offence under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506 read with Section 34 IPC.
4.
Since there is no representation on behalf of the petitioner, petition dismissed for non-prosecution.
